title: AI trade: Investors may want to look outside infrastructure, Nvidia
title_zh: 人工智能贸易：投资者可能希望关注基础设施之外的领域，英伟达
summary: All three of the major averages (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) ended Friday's session in positive territory — the Dow Jones Industrial Average leading the way and rising 294 points — managing to close out the trading week with gains.
summary_zh: 所有三个主要股指（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）周五均以上涨收盘——道琼斯工业平均指数领涨，上涨 294 点——成功以上涨结束了交易周。

title: SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic: Investors are 'better off' waiting for IPOs
title_zh: SpaceX、OpenAI、Anthropic：等待 IPO 的投资者“状况更好”
summary: Private markets are in focus, with initial public offerings (IPOs) from Anthropic (ANTH.PVT), OpenAI (OPAI.PVT), and SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) on the horizon.
summary_zh: 私募市场成为焦点，Anthropic (ANTH.PVT)、OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 和 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 的首次公开募股 (IPO) 即将到来。

title: Maybe investors can wait to buy SpaceX after IPO: Lee Munson
title_zh: Lee Munson：也许投资者可以等待 IPO 后购买 SpaceX
summary: Elon Musk's private space operator, SpaceX (SPAX.PVT), released its S-1 filing this week as it plans to go public via IPO in June. The Wall Street Journal has reported that AI developer OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) is preparing to file for its own mega-IPO.
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的私人太空运营商 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 本周发布了 S-1 文件，计划于 6 月通过 IPO 上市。据《华尔街日报》报道，人工智能开发商 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 正准备申请大型 IPO。

title: AI mania is fueling bubble-like concentration in the S&P 500
title_zh: 人工智能狂热正在助长标准普尔 500 指数泡沫般的集中度

title: 'Not a cost-cutting exercise': How tech CEOs are framing AI-driven layoffs
title_zh: “不是削减成本”：科技公司首席执行官如何制定人工智能驱动的裁员计划
summary: Layoff notifications have long included wording about tough decisions in challenging times. Now, they're also increasingly nodding at how automation is reshaping workforces and companies' priorities.
summary_zh: 长期以来，裁员通知中一直包含有关在充满挑战的时期做出艰难决定的措辞。现在，他们也越来越认可自动化如何重塑劳动力和公司的优先事项。
